messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spikes in 5xx for Pelion Systems (enterprise-vpc-42). Gateway 504/502s observed from eu-central-1 since 11:02 UTC. Pager dispatched to oncall.

maya: on it. seeing a surge from inference-gw-eu-1 -> pelion-dedicated-eu. error_rate ~18% over last 3m.

jonah: +1. any deploys in the last 30m?

leila: nothing in prod for Pelion in last hour. recent config push was a routing tweak but that was targeted at canary.

maya: checking pool metrics. pelion-dedicated-eu shows GPU memory pressure and connection queueing. warm nodes are stuck initializing (kicked by image pull).

maya: immediate mitigation: start traffic-shift, move most traffic to pelion-dedicated-us-west warm pool. will need DNS weighted change and short TTL to accelerate.

samir: alerting account team (cc @support-andy) so Pelion is aware. prep customer comms: "we're shifting traffic to alternate region to restore service; no data loss expected."

andy: crafting customer message now. ETA for first status note <= 10m.

jonah: can we verify warm capacity is healthy in us-west?

maya: checked Redwood Console -> Dedicated -> pelion-pool-us-west: warmCapacity=4, available=3, queued=0. CPU/GPU utilization nominal. ready to accept traffic.

leila: recommend staged weighted DNS change: eu 20% / us-west 80%; monitor 5m, then 0/100 if stable. current DNS record is a weighted Route53/Traffic-Director style entry with TTL 60s.

maya: doing DNS change now. command: ```aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z12345 --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"pelion.api.redwood.example","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"us-west","Weight":80,"TTL":60,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"52.10.10.5"}]}}]}'```

deploy-bot: DNS update job queued (job id dns-215112-1). will report status.

incident-bot: DNS job dns-215112-1 succeeded (propagation started).

maya: shifting live traffic now via control-plane routing override (force weight switch). command: ```redwoodctl route update --tenant pelion --route inference --weights eu=20,us-west=80 --dry-run=false```

jonah: see drop in 5xx in us-west backend checks. eu still degraded but traffic portion reduced.

maya: monitoring logs: gateway 504s in eu down from 18%->4% in last 3m. overall customer latency improved.

leila: keeping eu at 20% for 10 more minutes to ensure no backend surge. if stable, final switch to 0/100.

samir: Pelion CSM on call acknowledges. they want an incident window and ETA for eu pool recovery.

andy: customer message sent: "We shifted your traffic to an alternate regional pool to restore service while we investigate an initialization regression in the eu pool. We'll update in 30 minutes or earlier."

maya: eu pool root cause looks like image registry timeout during warm node init (external registry rate limit + flaky network path). opening infra ticket with registry provider and engineering.

jonah: we've kicked off a restart on the eu warm nodes with a fallback image (smaller layer) to avoid the registry pull. command: ```redwoodctl pool restart --pool pelion-dedicated-eu --image redwood/predictor:v2-small```

deploy-bot: restart job r-215112-7 started; health checks will report in 2m.

maya: eu warm nodes healthy now, node count back to expected. recommending weighted change to eu=0,us-west=100 for full failover until upstream registry fix verified.

leila: applying final weight change. command: ```redwoodctl route update --tenant pelion --route inference --weights eu=0,us-west=100```

incident-bot: route update completed (route-215112-2).

jonah: Confirming production metrics: error_rate <1%, p95 latency within SLOs.

maya: handing off to night oncall for monitoring. next_oncall: @leila (starts 11:45 UTC). leaving notes: monitor for registry failures, leave DNS TTL at 60s, do not revert until registry provider confirms fix or we've rolled back to prior image permanently.

leila: ack, taking handoff. added incident tag INC-215112 and will escalate if re-occurs.

samir: following up with Pelion leadership; they've requested a postmortem and timeline. will schedule a call for 16:00 UTC.

andy: note for post-incident: customer impact window ~11:02-11:18 UTC, mitigation by traffic shift and eu node restart. no data loss. recording for SLA credit assessment.

maya: closing thread for active mitigation. will follow up with a short timeline and RCA draft. :white_check_mark:
